name: Kasuya Devil's Recipe
author: Tetsu Kasuya
summary: Designed specifically for dark or medium-dark roasts to eliminate all bitterness and astringency while highlighting rich chocolate and caramel sweetness.
tasteNotes: Deep, velvety chocolate, toasted almond sweetness, heavy syrupy mouthfeel and zero bitterness or dry astringency.

steps.note: Low temp bloom at 82 °C. Gently swirl to wet all grounds.
Pour gently to 120 g in small concentric circles.
Remove dripper at 3:30 even if some water remains.

tips: Strictly keep water temperature between 80 °C and 83 °C.
Do not let the final astringent drops enter your cup; remove the dripper before it fully drains.
